title: Nanoose Creek Campground

services.name: Nanoose Creek Campground
services.desc: Drive over the creek into the trees - mid‑island camping for big rigs and tents, Wi‑Fi, trails, and spring water. 1. Pick arrival and departure under the calendar. 2. Send the form - we reply with a reference you can use on the status page (dates and approval only; no personal details shown there). 3. Optional: pay a deposit with PayPal from this page. Rather call or email? Use the number and address in Contact - or the email draft button under the form. Online booking is paused. Please call 250‑468‑7186 or email mccamp@shaw.ca to reserve. You can still browse the availability calendar below. Tap a date for tonight’s snapshot, then use Plan this stay in the window to check your whole trip,

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Forest RV park and tenting on mid Vancouver Island - Nanoose Bay, BC. Serviced sites, Wi‑Fi, trails, spring water.
